items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: Peers, Jack Peers. Yes. Our next door neighbor, when we were living here

ctx.x: Everything that happened happened, you know, because it had to happen. Like, I couldn't get inside to collect people and come to, you know, stand at the inner carriage or at the door. I couldn't get inside at all. So I had to start asking people to make a donation. But, you know, we went away when somebody started asking for the keys that we made a donation, too. We went, was it Jack, was it Jack Beach? Yeah, he wouldn't like to go out on the city or something, he wouldn't like to go out on the city or something.
Oh yeah. I heard, you're the photographer. No, no, Jack.
Oh, John Beecher? No, B.J. and Jack. Yeah, Peers.
